name: Night Hag

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.summary: With two hag allies within 30 ft., casts one of six divination/utility spells, each once per Long Rest.
traits.text: While at least two allied hags are within 30 feet of it, the hag can cast Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying or Unseen Servant, with no Material components, the spell's normal casting time, Intelligence as its spellcasting ability and a spell save DC of 14. After casting a spell this way, it can't cast that same spell with this trait again until it finishes a Long Rest.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
traits.text: The hag has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Soul Bag
traits.summary: Carries a soul bag (AC 15, HP 20, Resistance to all damage) that powers Nightmare Haunting.
traits.text: The hag owns a soul bag, and it can use Nightmare Haunting only while it holds or carries the bag. The bag has AC 15, 20 Hit Points and Resistance to all damage. At 0 Hit Points the bag crumbles to dust and frees every soul inside it. The hag can make a replacement bag after 7 days.

actions.name: Claw
actions.summary: Rends a target with iron-hard claws.

actions.name: Nightmare Haunting
actions.summary: Once a day, from the Ethereal Plane with its soul bag: casts Dream to drain a sleeper's life.
actions.text: Requires the soul bag; once per day. While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag casts Dream (Intelligence, spell save DC 14). The hag must be the spell's messenger, and the target must be a creature on the Material Plane that the hag can see. The spell fails and is wasted if the target is protected by Protection from Evil and Good or stands within a Magic Circle. Damage the target takes from the spell also lowers its Hit Point maximum by the same amount. If the spell kills the target, its soul is trapped in the soul bag, and the creature can't be raised from the dead until the soul is freed.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: Casts Detect Magic, Etherealness, Magic Missile at will; Phantasmal Killer, Plane Shift 2/day.
actions.text: The hag casts one of these spells, needing no Material components and using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14). At will: Detect Magic, Etherealness, Magic Missile (cast as a level 4 spell). 2/day each: Phantasmal Killer, Plane Shift (self only).

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.summary: Takes the form of a Small or Medium Humanoid, or returns to its true form.
bonus_actions.text: The hag turns into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or back into its true form. Its statistics stay the same in every form except its size. Equipment it wears or carries doesn't change with it.

coven.name: Shared Spellcasting (Coven)
coven.summary: While two coven sisters stand within 30 ft., she casts from the coven's shared spells and slots (DC 15, +7).
coven.text: While two other hags of her coven are within 30 feet of her, the hag can cast the coven's shared spells, using slots the coven shares: 1st level (4 slots): Ray of Sickness; 2nd level (3 slots): Hold Person; 3rd level (3 slots): Bestow Curse, Counterspell, Lightning Bolt; 4th level (3 slots): Phantasmal Killer, Polymorph; 6th level (1 slot): Eyebite. She uses Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). From the 2014 Monster Manual's hag covens, for a fight that seats a whole coven; its divinations (Identify, Locate Object, Contact Other Plane, Scrying) and their slots are left out.

shapes.name: Disguise
shapes.summary: The Humanoid she passes as (a Small or Medium woman): her statistics stay the same.

summary: Opens with Phantasmal Killer and level 4 Magic Missiles, claws anyone close, and slips away ethereally.
